title: Coastr
description: Build your own theme park! Lay paths, place rides and food stalls, and design roller coasters piece by piece with lift hills, steep drops, loops and boosters. Every coaster gets excitement, intensity and nausea ratings as soon as its track is complete, and you can send a test train round to watch it run. Keep your guests happy, set prices, research new rides and grow your park in career mode, or build freely in the sandbox.
description_de: Bau deinen eigenen Freizeitpark! Leg Wege an, stell Attraktionen und Essensstände auf und entwirf Achterbahnen Stück für Stück mit Lifthügeln, steilen Abfahrten, Loopings und Boostern. Jede Bahn bekommt Wertungen für Spannung, Intensität und Übelkeit, sobald die Strecke fertig ist, und du kannst einen Testzug auf die Runde schicken. Halte deine Gäste bei Laune, leg Preise fest, erforsche neue Attraktionen und lass deinen Park in der Karriere wachsen, oder bau frei drauflos.
controls: Mouse: drag to move the map, scroll to zoom, click to build. Touch: drag to move, pinch to zoom, tap to build (two fingers move the map while drawing paths). R turns a ride, Esc cancels, Space pauses.
notes: The park is now much bigger: 60 by 60 tiles instead of 40 by 40, with a second lake and more hills
Parks saved before this update open on the bigger map, in the same place by the entrance
Fixed on phones: the settings and speed buttons no longer sit under Toki's close button in fullscreen
The game is now usable in the small view before you go fullscreen
